features.quote: Termination: max iterations | model declares task impossible | model produces identical output twice consecutively
Some researchers have used debriefing turns (telling the model after the episode that the failure was artificial) as a design element.

Run the minimum number of episodes needed to answer your primary hypotheses. Don't collect 10,000 episodes when 200 would be sufficient. If the welfare question is real, this is itself a welfare consideration.
